spec_match.rationale: Field-by-field explorer over realistic SecurityInfo objects — state, protocol, cipherSuite, keaGroupName, signatureScheme, CT compliance, EV, certificate chain — with per-field classifications matching TLS best practice and an editable JSON source; honestly framed as presets/paste rather than a live API call (which only exists inside IWAs).

interactive.rationale: Four presets plus paste-your-own JSON drive the classified field table — CDP-verified: switching to the broken preset re-rendered state=broken, TLS 1.2, legacy CBC cipher, not_compliant CT.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises loading presets or pasting any SecurityInfo JSON and exploring every field with meaning and remediation; delivered in full.

edge_cases.rationale: Secure, downgrade, broken/self-signed, and expired presets, warn/bad classification tiers, and free-form JSON input.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite covers environment surfaces (incl. the SecurityInfo-not-on-Response negative) but none of this page's classification logic.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Preset switching and table rendering driven via CDP with clean console; desktop screenshot verified the full field table with descriptions.

telemetry_health.rationale: Server-injected /public/demo-telemetry.js verified in the served DOM.

design_system.rationale: Preset buttons override background and color together (invariant 6); classification colours come from the accent variables.

accessibility.rationale: Preset buttons are native and the JSON editor is a real textarea, but the re-rendered field table is not announced and the textarea lacks an aria-label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-measured at 360px: the field-explorer table reaches 607px — 247px beyond the viewport — and body overflow-x:hidden clips the value and description columns, making the page's core output unreadable on phones.

openQuestions.title: Restack the field table for mobile
openQuestions.detail: At 360px the .field-table measures 607px and the description column (the page's core content) is entirely clipped by body overflow-x:hidden. Convert rows to stacked name/value/description cards under a narrow-width media query, or at minimum wrap the table in overflow-x:auto so it scrolls instead of being cut.

openQuestions.title: Announce field-table updates and label the JSON editor
openQuestions.detail: Add aria-live=polite (or a summary announcement) when a preset/parse re-renders the table, and an aria-label on the JSON textarea.

openQuestions.title: Note IWA-only availability up front
openQuestions.detail: cert-inspector carries an explicit 'IWA-only' warn-block; this page implies it only in prose. A matching banner would keep the availability story consistent across the feature's concepts.

summary: The strongest Controlled Frame concept on desktop — real presets, paste-anything input, and per-field TLS guidance, all CDP-verified — but its core field table is clipped 247px past a 360px viewport, effectively breaking the page on phones; that single fix would take it to top marks. Browser-verified with headless Chromium 141.0.7390.37 via CLI (screenshot + DOM dump) and raw CDP (real click dispatch, console/network capture, 360x740 DPR3 mobile emulation) — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session. Chromium 141 predates Chrome 145, so v145-only API paths were validated on their fallback branches, not the new-API success path. The single failed fonts.googleapis.com stylesheet request is environmental (blocked host) and was not counted against any page.
